name: air temperature
definition: How warm the air is about two metres above the ground, averaged over the month.

name: daily high temperature
definition: The warmest the air gets each day, about two metres above the ground, averaged over the month.

name: daily low temperature
definition: The coolest the air gets each day, about two metres above the ground, averaged over the month.

name: ground surface temperature
definition: How warm the very surface of the land or sea is, averaged over the month.

name: precipitation
definition: How much rain and snow falls, as the average depth of water per day over the month.

name: snowfall
definition: How much snow falls, as the depth of water it would melt into per day, averaged over the month.

name: relative humidity
definition: How close the air is to holding all the water vapour it can, as a percentage, averaged over the month.

name: wind speed
definition: How fast the wind blows about two metres above the ground, averaged over the month.

name: sunlight at the ground
definition: How much energy from sunlight reaches the ground each day, cloudy days included, averaged over the month.
source: NASA POWER monthly (CERES SYN1deg), API v2.10.0

name: cloud cover
definition: How much of the sky is covered by cloud, as a percentage, averaged over the month.
source: NASA POWER monthly (CERES SYN1deg), API v2.10.0
